prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1020; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the right-hand lane on a Conroe, Texas roadway when Driver 2 attempted a lane change into the same space and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported a concussion following the impact and was assessed at the scene. Officers confirmed that Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and this was also consistent with statements given at the scene. The damage to the left side of Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the sideswipe described, and the scene photographs show the same contact points. No independent witnesses were located to observe the lane change. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to the reporting officer. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. The injury described is consistent with the type and force of the collision as observed at the scene.
